issuer: the competent office of the Department for Transport (Dipartimento per i trasporti, la navigazione e i sistemi informativi e statistici), the Motorizzazione civile
note: Read 2026-10-30 on Normattiva, the state's official database of law, in the Highway Code (Codice della strada, d.lgs. 285/1992). Art. 115 (text in force from 15 January 2021) sets 18 as the age to drive the vehicles a category B licence covers; art. 116 (in force from 6 August 2022) says licences are issued by the competent office of the Department for Transport to people resident in Italy; art. 126 (in force from 6 August 2022) says category B licences are valid for ten years, five once issued or confirmed past 50 and three past 70. So the licence is kept from 18 for ten years. The issuing fee (the Department's charges and the stamp duties) wasn't read from a primary source today (the Ministry's site didn't connect), so it is null. The identity card (carta d'identità) is the ids engine's. No exchange list was read.
